name: What is a tiny-home shell?
description: A tiny-home shell is the structural, weather-tight exterior of a tiny house, providing a foundation for owner-completed interiors.

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny-home shell provides the basic structure of a tiny house, typically including the exterior walls, roof, subfloor, and a trailer if it's on wheels. It’s essentially a weather-tight enclosure, offering a solid foundation for homeowners to complete the interior themselves. This option allows for significant customization and can be a cost-effective way to build a tiny home by saving on professional finishing labor. Zen Tiny Homes constructs these shells, providing a crucial starting point for your project.
